jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Dovetail is the Customer Intelligence Platform for the entire organization. We unify fragmented feedback from every touchpoint, including sales calls, support tickets, and research, into a single AI-powered intelligence layer that empowers every team to build, sell, and serve with confidence. Founded in 2017, we are a team of 100+ across our offices in Sydney and San Francisco, working with thousands of teams from Fortune 500 companies to the world’s most innovative startups.

The best never guess. We help teams turn the noise of thousands of customer interactions into the signal required to move faster, prioritize better, and drive revenue.

We’re building a team of incredibly talented product designers. At Dovetail, designers are accountable for crafting experiences, interactions, and solutions that improve the product for our customers, and drive user adoption. This role places a stronger emphasis on visual design, prototyping, usability testing, and evolving our design system. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer with great attention to detail who can create experiences that reflect our incredibly high bar for quality.

This is a full-time in person-first role (in office 4 days a week), working from our Surry Hills HQ.

What you’ll do

  • Champion customer feedback in every decision. Build a deep understanding of customer needs, perspectives, and goals by talking to customers regularly, getting involved in research, running your own evaluative testing, participating in our community, and responding to feedback. Use tools like archetypes and journey maps to help your team build a shared understanding of the customer.

  • Design simple, intuitive and delightful product experiences. Balance customer needs with business goals and technical constraints, drawing on research, UX, interaction, and visual design to create solutions that feel seamless and easy to use.

  • Drive design through collaboration. Work closely with product, engineering, GTM, leadership and other designers to shape and ship thoughtful, high-impact features.

  • Prototype and pair closely with engineers. Stay close to implementation and sweat the details to make sure what we ship meets a high bar for quality.

  • Contribute to our design system. Partner with designers and engineers to create and evolve patterns and components that can be shared across the product.

  • Help shape our design team culture. We’re a small but quickly growing team, and you’ll help us scale our design rituals and design system, maintain a high quality bar as the product team grows, tackle cross-product problems, and find better ways to work together as a team.

What you’ll bring

  • Strong product design experience. Experience designing modern B2B cloud software, ideally in startups or other fast-moving product teams.

  • Breadth across the design process. Comfortable moving from product discovery through to detailed design. You can quickly visualise and prototype concepts to communicate and iterate on ideas with stakeholders, then carry them through to polished, well-considered solutions.

  • Excited to experiment with AI. You’re curious about AI tools and fast prototyping approaches and keen to explore how they can improve the way you design and work.

  • Attention to detail. You have a high quality bar and are always looking for ways to improve the customer experience. You’re comfortable pushing pixels and sweating the details, we’re a detail-oriented company that cares about quality.

  • Clear communication and stakeholder management. You communicate openly, thoughtfully and honestly with teammates, founders and customers. You’re confident sharing product and design direction, framing challenges and opportunities and building alignment to move team towards an outcome.

  • Highly collaborative working style. You’re comfortable working closely with product managers, engineers, and other teammates to plan, prioritise and deliver high-impact features together.

  • Pragmatic mindset. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, changing priorities, and shifting deadlines. You’re resourceful when solving problems and can make sensible trade-offs while keeping the bigger strategic goal in mind.

  • A great attitude. You’re comfortable with the pace, urgency, risk, and uncertainty that come with an early-stage startup and excited by the opportunity to help shape the product and company as we grow.

Why you'll love it here

We hire smart people and look after them well! Here's the deal:

📈 Equity for everyone. Competitive base salary plus options, so every builder is aligned on long-term impact.

🏢 A place to do your best work, wherever you are. Our Sydney office is built for in-person first collaboration. Our US team runs on a flexible remote setup. Either way, you've got what you need.

🤝 Built in connection. Join a Doveclub, bond with your team regularly, and celebrate the small wins, big milestones, and cultural moments with the whole company.

📚 Learn and thrive. Flexible L&D and wellness benefits, choose between a generous $3000 L&D allowance, or up to $1000 on wellness.

🌴 Time to recharge. Four weeks of accrued leave, floating public holidays, and gifted bonus Kit Kat days sprinkled throughout the year.

🌍 Four weeks from anywhere. Up to four weeks a year doing your job from anywhere in the world. Split it up or use it all at once.

🍼 Generous parental leave. We offer 20 weeks for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers, plus return-to-work support.

🎉 Four weeks at four years. Four years is a long time in tech, and we value loyalty. Take an additional four weeks off to reset and recharge.

🩺 Stellar US benefits. Comprehensive health, dental, vision, 401(k), and more through Sequoia.

At Dovetail, we're building a place where every team member feels supported and valued. We celebrate individualism and want you to show up as your authentic self every day. It’s no secret that diversity builds the best teams, large or small, so we highly encourage applications from people who identify as part of an underrepresented group.

On AI: We expect candidates to already be embedding AI into their day-to-day work. We look for people who are thoughtful and pragmatic in how they use AI—knowing when to leverage it, how to direct it effectively, and how to apply it to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work.

jobs.title: Account Executive (Enterprise)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Dovetail is the Customer Intelligence Platform for the entire organization. We unify fragmented feedback from every touchpoint, including sales calls, support tickets, and research, into a single AI-powered intelligence layer that empowers every team to build, sell, and serve with confidence. Founded in 2017, we are a team of 100+ across our offices in Sydney and San Francisco, working with thousands of teams from Fortune 500 companies to the world’s most innovative startups.

The best never guess. We help teams turn the noise of thousands of customer interactions into the signal required to move faster, prioritize better, and drive revenue.

The role

We're looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to join Dovetail and own the full sales cycle for our largest and most strategic accounts. You'll partner with some of the world's most sophisticated organizations to solve complex problems with a consultative, value-led approach, while helping shape how our Customer Intelligence Platform scales into the enterprise. If you love navigating multi-stakeholder deals and want to have a real impact in a high-growth SaaS environment, this role is for you.

Please note that we're only able to accept applicants who are based in the following states for this role: California, Texas, Michigan, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Arizona, New York, and Florida.

What you will do

  • Manage the end-to-end enterprise sales process. You'll own the full sales cycle for our largest prospects, from initial engagement to close, running multi-threaded deals across procurement, IT, legal, security, and executive stakeholders. You'll navigate long, complex cycles without losing momentum.

  • Employ a consultative, value-based sales approach. You'll build a business case tailored to each stakeholder, from the economic buyer to the technical evaluator, and deliver demonstrations that speak to each audience's priorities.

  • Sell an AI-native platform, the AI-native way. You'll speak fluently to how Dovetail's AI turns fragmented feedback into decision-ready intelligence, including how it handles enterprise-grade security and governance questions, and you'll use AI tools yourself to research accounts, prepare for multi-stakeholder calls, and manage the volume of detail a long enterprise cycle demands.

  • Become a Dovetail expert. You'll develop an intimate knowledge of how Dovetail works, what Dovetail is capable of, and an understanding of the competitive and market landscape at the enterprise tier so you can position confidently against alternatives.

  • Build and manage a strategic account plan. You'll map organizations, identify champions, and build relationships across departments to expand your footprint within each account over time.

  • Develop and maintain deep executive relationships with your prospects. You'll manage the trust and stakeholder alignment that enterprise deals require, and partner closely with customer success to ensure a smooth handoff and a strong foundation for expansion.

  • Help mature our Enterprise go-to-market motion. You'll work with the Sales team to refine how we sell into large, complex organizations, and pioneer new practices as we build out our product-led sales strategy.

What you will bring

  • Experience in a consultative, value-based sales role for an enterprise SaaS business.

  • Proven experience closing large, complex deals in a high-growth sales environment. Help us identify you by sharing your results, including deal size and cycle length. Ideally, you would have also contributed to building an enterprise sales motion at an early-stage company.

  • Extensive experience managing multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including procurement, security, and legal review processes, while delivering a positive experience for every stakeholder involved.

  • AI fluency as a working habit. You already use AI tools to prospect, research, and prepare for complex deals, and you can point to specific ways they've made you faster or sharper, not just that you've tried them.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the operational skills to develop, report on, simplify, and improve sales processes.

  • Executive-level communication so you can convey your thoughts, opinions, and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders and internal teammates alike.

  • The right attitude towards a sense of urgency, risk, and ambiguity that naturally comes with working at an early-stage start-up, balanced with the patience a long enterprise cycle demands.

Why you'll love it here

🤝 Built in connection. Join a Doveclub, bond with your team regularly, and celebrate the small wins, big milestones, and cultural moments with the whole company.

📚 Learn and thrive. Flexible L&D and wellness benefits, choose between a generous $3000 L&D allowance, or up to $1000 on wellness.

🌴 Time to recharge. Four weeks of accrued leave, floating public holidays, and gifted bonus Kit Kat days sprinkled throughout the year.

jobs.title: Growth Marketer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Dovetail is the Customer Intelligence Platform for the entire organization. We unify fragmented feedback from every touchpoint, including sales calls, support tickets, and research, into a single AI-powered intelligence layer that empowers every team to build, sell, and serve with confidence. Founded in 2017, we are a team of 100+ across our offices in Sydney and San Francisco, working with thousands of teams from Fortune 500 companies to the world’s most innovative startups.

The best never guess. We help teams turn the noise of thousands of customer interactions into the signal required to move faster, prioritize better, and drive revenue.

About the role

As our Growth Marketer, you will partner with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Creative, Web, Data, and Revenue Operations to build Dovetail’s acquisition and lifecycle growth engine.

You’ll own paid acquisition and email end to end, from channel strategy and budget allocation through to audiences, creative, landing pages, lifecycle journeys, tracking, and pipeline performance. You’ll start with high-intent search, account-targeted paid social, retargeting, and the email programs that turn interest into action, then open new channels when the evidence supports it.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a builder. You’ll set direction, work directly inside the platforms, and turn what works into a repeatable system. This is a full-time in person-first role (in office 4 days a week), working from our Surry Hills HQ.

What you’ll do

  • Own paid acquisition. Set the channel strategy, budget, targets, forecast, and testing roadmap across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, retargeting, and selected emerging channels. Know what is running, why it is running, and how it is performing.

  • Run campaigns hands-on. Build and optimize campaign structures, bids, audiences, exclusions, copy, creative variants, and conversion paths. Fix problems in the account yourself rather than waiting for an agency report.

  • Own email and lifecycle marketing. Build the journeys that move prospects from first signal to qualified opportunity, including nurture, behavioral triggers, campaign follow-up, re-engagement, and database activation. Own segmentation, testing, deliverability, measurement, and the systems behind them.

  • Turn performance into better creative. Partner with Creative and Product Marketing to build a fast learning loop across message, format, audience, and offer. Explain why a concept worked so the insight improves the next campaign, not only the next ad.

  • Improve the post-click journey. Partner with Web to ship landing pages, forms, and conversion experiments that match the intent behind each campaign. Own the commercial hypothesis and performance readout from click through qualified opportunity.

  • Build a high-velocity testing practice. Set clear hypotheses and decision rules before launch. Test channels, queries, audiences, creative, offers, landing pages, email journeys, and bid strategies. Scale what works, and stop what does not.

  • Connect spend to pipeline. Partner with Revenue Operations and Data to build trustworthy tracking, attribution, dashboards, and feedback loops. Measure success through qualified pipeline, customer acquisition cost, and revenue, not clicks or lead volume.

  • Build an AI-powered growth system. Design and operate the workflows, prompts, agents, and tooling that improve campaign production, lifecycle orchestration, monitoring, analysis, creative iteration, and reporting. Partner with Engineering and Web to automate work that should not stay manual.

Skills and experience

  • Paid acquisition depth. Experience in growth or performance marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS, with direct operating experience across Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads. Experience with Meta, YouTube, Reddit, programmatic, or emerging AI search surfaces is useful.

  • Email and lifecycle depth. Experience building segmented B2B journeys across nurture, campaign follow-up, re-engagement, and behavioral triggers. You understand deliverability, testing, automation, and how email contributes to pipeline across a considered buying journey.

  • Commercial ownership. A track record of managing meaningful budgets and improving qualified pipeline, customer acquisition cost, or revenue. You can show where you scaled spend, where you held it, and where you stopped.

  • AI fluency as craft. Hands-on with modern AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT, with examples of workflows, agents, and prompts you have improved over time. You see AI as a system to operate, not a button to press.

  • A systems and tooling builder. Comfortable owning the paid and lifecycle stack end to end, including campaign taxonomy, conversion events, pixels, conversion APIs, audience sync, email automation, and source-of-truth reporting.

  • Strong analytical judgment. You can interrogate funnel data, separate signal from noise, and turn a performance readout into a clear decision. You understand attribution’s limits and know when the evidence is strong enough to act.

  • Creative taste. You can judge the message, hook, visual, offer, and landing-page experience, then give clear direction on what needs to change. You do not treat creative as an input someone else owns.

  • Hands-on in the weeds. You audit the account, build the audience, write the ad, inspect the tracking, review the landing page, pull the data, and ship the next test. You do the work, not just direct it.

  • A strong cross-functional collaborator across Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Creative, Web, Revenue Operations, Data, Sales, and Engineering.

  • Bias to action. You would rather launch a disciplined test, learn from real behavior, and improve the system than wait for perfect information.

Experience with Google Analytics, Segment, HubSpot, Salesforce, SQL, or a product analytics platform is useful, but evidence of what you have built and improved matters more than a perfect match to our stack.

Why you'll love it here

📈 Equity for everyone. Competitive base salary plus options, so every builder is aligned on long-term impact.

🏢 A place to do your best work, wherever you are. Our Sydney office is built for in-person first collaboration. Our US team runs on a flexible remote setup. Either way, you've got what you need.

🤝 Built in connection. Join a Doveclub, bond with your team regularly, and celebrate the small wins, big milestones, and cultural moments with the whole company.

📚 Learn and thrive. Flexible L&D and wellness benefits, choose between a generous $3000 L&D allowance, or up to $1000 on wellness.

🌴 Time to recharge. Four weeks of accrued leave, floating public holidays, and gifted bonus Kit Kat days sprinkled throughout the year.

🌍 Four weeks from anywhere. Up to four weeks a year doing your job from anywhere in the world. Split it up or use it all at once.

🍼 Generous parental leave. We offer 20 weeks for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers, plus return-to-work support.

🎉 Four weeks at four years. Four years is a long time in tech, and we value loyalty. Take an additional four weeks off to reset and recharge.

🩺 Stellar US benefits. Comprehensive health, dental, vision, 401(k), and more through Sequoia.
